verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's marketing says it automates routine work and "moves cases between agents and your team" while keeping decisions defensible (hummingbird-docs-22). It also offers customizable automation for dispositioning alerts (hummingbird-docs-23) and workflows configured to mirror an organization's policies (hummingbird-docs-20), with peer approval steps (hummingbird-docs-19). Together these suggest a policy-shaped split between automated and human work, but the support is thin and mostly marketing copy. Missing for 10: documented policy controls that cap or gate automatic dispositioning, explicit risk-based or ambiguity-based escalation rules routing cases to humans, documentation of the AI agent's decision boundaries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
